scene: The happy seagull squawks loudly, startling nearby transit drivers into action.
picture: A flat side view of the pier edge. Far left hangs an open wooden lift basket rigged to heavy ropes. Left of centre idles a neon-painted skate shuttle bus. Centre stands the dark-haired boy clutching his cone and skateboard beside the perched gull. Right stands a bright red double-decker bus with doors open.
shown: A wooden rope-bridge lift basket hangs open on the far left. Door open. Waiting.
A bright neon mini-bus parked left of centre, side doors sliding wide open.
A red double-decker bus parked at the right curb with its folding doors open.
